subject: Australia
purpose: Behind-the-scenes source coverage and progression graph. It is not a checklist UI or a replacement for the actual location-backed practice pack.

sources.title: Plonk It Australia
sources.visualReview: Card contents and image URLs extracted; candidate panorama visibility still requires review.

countingRules: 178 source units are source observations/aggregate reference cards, not 178 independent mastery targets.
Named families group overlap conservatively; a family may require several later atomic tasks.
The 20 existing LM skill IDs remain the only associations to the current runtime pack; catalog coverage does not create practice availability.

requiredBeforeNewSkillActivation: verified claim and caveats, with contemporary check where flagged
multiple actual cue-visible panoramas with reviewed labels and orientation
teaching/assessment split with panorama identity deduplication
activationRules.masteryEvidence: Only actual valid learner recognition/application attempts count. Source ingestion and correct guesses alone do not establish mastery.
activationRules.progressionInterpretation: Authored pedagogical structure rather than a validated optimal schedule; unavailable source units never become fake practice or mastery.

progressionFamilies.title: Recognize the country
progressionFamilies.rationale: Learn the broad visual features that separate Australia from realistic neighboring-country alternatives. Learners who can already do this may enter at state anchors.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: Country identification demonstrated on varied unseen scenes; source cards or self-report alone do not establish transfer.

progressionFamilies.title: Read broad landscape families
progressionFamilies.rationale: Combine vegetation, climate, terrain and land use before attaching state names. This limits overreliance on isolated infrastructure clues.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: Recognize multiple scene families and contrast similar landscapes across state boundaries; do not score a single teaching panorama as generalization.

progressionFamilies.title: Build dependable state anchors
progressionFamilies.rationale: Start a small active set of clearly visible state clues with diverse examples. NSW plates and WA signposts are the current location-backed starting pair, not the full syllabus.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: Recognition feedback plus correct regional application on multiple distinct panoramas. Correct pin placement alone is insufficient.

progressionFamilies.title: Resolve confusable clues
progressionFamilies.rationale: Contrast similar poles, posts, reflectors and signs, retaining both positive examples and foils. Return errors to the active set without discarding older learning.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: Distinguish the cue from its nearest look-alikes on unfamiliar locations, including known exceptions.

progressionFamilies.title: Combine clues to regionguess
progressionFamilies.rationale: Combine scene context with infrastructure, settlements and route information across regions within and between states.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: Apply multiple independent cues to mixed, unfamiliar scenes; separate clue recognition from geographic precision.

progressionFamilies.title: Add specialist and corridor clues
progressionFamilies.rationale: Add route systems, local utility tags, coverage artifacts and rare vehicles after their foundations. Time-sensitive rules require contemporary checks.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: Current claims corroborated; distinguish local and historical patterns from hard geographic boundaries.

progressionFamilies.title: Retain and transfer
progressionFamilies.rationale: Use delayed and previously unseen mixed locations to test retention and regional reasoning. Repeated anchor panoramas measure familiarity rather than transfer.
progressionFamilies.evidenceGate: A separate assessment pool, no shared panoramas with teaching anchors, delayed attempts, and no hints before guessing.
